responsibilities: As a BI Developer, you'll transform data into clear, actionable insights that help shape decisions across our global business.
You'll work closely with stakeholders to understand their reporting and analytics needs, designing and developing dashboards and reports that provide real business value.
Building scalable reporting solutions, monitoring and improving data quality, and identify opportunities to optimise existing processes.
From supporting regulatory reporting to carrying out ad-hoc analysis, you'll play an important role in ensuring our teams have the data they need to make informed decisions.

You'll also help evolve our BI capabilities by contributing ideas, improving performance and embracing new technologies, including AI-powered tools, to enhance the way we build and maintain reporting solutions.
